sources.label: Axis Asset Composition tab, reporting date October 2, 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The rendered Asset Composition tab publishes five gross asset-form categories totaling 100%, before hedge offsets. Percentages are copied without extrapolating constituent holdings or hedge notional. Accountable independently reports reserve and supply totals and anonymized venue splits, but does not reconcile these five categories or establish hedge coverage. The issuer dashboard's 06:34 UTC reporting checkpoint is separate from live RPC supply and the later Accountable checkpoint; no cross-source ratio or liability partition is asserted. Mixed inventory and unallocated instrument baskets retain conservative legacy risk tiers rather than borrowing the best named constituent's tier.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer Asset Composition tab: 70.73/21.41/6.25/1.31/0.30 percent of gross backing at the October 2, 2026 reporting date; gross asset form before hedge offsets, not delta-adjusted net exposure.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Unresolved constituent identities and dependency weights cover the 27.96% stablecoin, staked/yield and tokenized-Treasury baskets. The remaining liquid inventory and fiat/FX categories are classified as untracked exogenous assets, not resolved custody or hedging protections. Across the complete portfolio, exact venue identities and allocation, hedge notionals, margin headroom, legal ownership and enforceable recovery rights remain unresolved; custodyProfile separately retains 100% uncertainty. Named USYC and USDG do not establish measurable tracked-coin dependency weights.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: BTC, ETH, SOL, xNVDA and other approved liquid inventory are external assets; no tracked stablecoin share or per-position hedge allocation is supplied.
The dashboard describes approved fiat-backed stablecoins without exact identities and weights. Accepted USDC/USDT deposits do not prove current reserve allocations.
stETH and bnSOL are named examples alongside other approved instruments, without exhaustive identities or weights. No synthetic dollar dependency is inferred.
Fiat and FX balances at bank, venue or settlement accounts are not tracked stablecoin token holdings.

sources.label: Axis custody and on-venue inventory disclosure

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The deposit address is an entry point, not a whole-book custodian. Docs say no current off-exchange custody, while the same reporting-date dashboard assigns 2.83% to qualified custody and 1.04% to onchain derivatives margin. This contradiction remains unresolved, so custodyModel is unknown rather than a whole-book CEX or institutional tier. Dashboard location percentages are not named-provider shares or legal segregation evidence; no share is assigned to the deposit address or a guessed venue.
